subject: Invitation to Company Networking Event
body: Dear valued employees, You are invited to our annual company networking event on Friday, October 15th from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Join us for an evening of networking, food, and drinks at the Grand Ballroom. This event is a great opportunity to connect with colleagues from different departments and establish new connections. Please RSVP by October 10th. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Event Planning Committee
